summary: Rows of the same kind of thing, compared column by column.
note: Figma models a table as columns side by side; HTML has no column element, so the code is row-oriented. Figma's column Types are cell content here, not variants.

pairs.dont: Use a table to lay out a form or a set of cards.
pairs.do: Use a table when the reader needs to compare the same field across rows.
pairs.why: A table earns its density by making columns scannable. Used as a layout grid it inherits all the cost — the semantics, the scrolling, the alignment — and returns none of it.

pairs.dont: Split one record across two rows to fit more fields.
pairs.do: Use the Title + supporting cell to stack a second line inside one row.
pairs.why: Every row is one record, for a reader and for a screen reader. A record that spans two rows breaks selection, sorting and counting at once.

pairs.do: Right-align numbers and set them in mono.
pairs.why: Digits only line up by place value when they are right-aligned in a fixed-width face. Left-aligned figures cannot be compared down a column, which is the only reason they are in one.

pairs.dont: Write "MOS (calculated hourly, 0–5)" in the column header.
pairs.do: Head the column "MOS" and put the rest in a caption or a tooltip.
pairs.why: The header repeats in assistive technology on every cell in the column. A sentence there is read dozens of times.

pairs.dont: Track selection on the checkbox and leave the row unmarked.
pairs.do: Set the selected state on the row, so it reads and looks selected.
pairs.why: The thing being selected is the record, not the tick. A screen reader that hears "checked" without "selected" has to infer the connection.

pairs.dont: Render a header with nothing under it.
pairs.do: Say what would be here and how to get it — or that a filter is hiding it.
pairs.why: An empty table looks identical whether there is no data, no match, or a failed request, and the reader cannot tell which.

pairs.dont: Reach for sm to squeeze in another column.
pairs.do: Use sm when a table is a supporting panel, and md when it is the page.
pairs.why: Shrinking the row height does not create horizontal room. If columns do not fit, the answer is fewer columns or a scroll, not tighter rows.

a11y: aria-selected belongs on the row, not on the checkbox inside it. The checkbox says what it does; the row says what it is.
Selection is a fill plus aria-selected, never the fill alone.
